races.name: Watch Unibet Racing Postcast Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Le Beau Madrik
runners_data.note: Front-running style suits small field but 46 days off and RPR of 137 suggests he may have improved beyond this level
runners_data.comment: 2-2 over hurdles until flat performance at Kelso; back from a break with yard riding high
runners_data.spotlight: Posted a very eyecatching RPR when making it 2-2 over hurdles at Newcastle in January (2m4f, soft; fine on good) and reportedly ran flat when only 7-2 for a Grade 2 at Kelso the following month; granted a break since then and he returns with his yard firing in winners left, right and centre.

runners_data.name: Matty's Getaway
runners_data.note: Prominent style with first-time tongue-tie addition could unlock further improvement after 138 days away from track
runners_data.comment: Took a notable scalp in November; major player provided the absence doesn't hold him back
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner who has been keeping good company over hurdles and, in a first-time tongue-tie, he comfortably accounted for subsequent Grade 2 winner Dalston Lad in a Doncaster maiden in late November (2m5f, good to soft); has since undergone a wind operation; major player provided the absence doesn't hold him back.

runners_data.name: Legendary Luke
runners_data.note: Natural leader who handles good ground well but step back from 3m Grade 2 level may have knocked confidence
runners_data.comment: Relinquished his unbeaten record over hurdles in a 3m Grade 2 here in February
runners_data.spotlight: 3m point winner; relinquished his unbeaten record over hurdles in a 3m Grade 2 here in February but that was no backward step and he'd have finished closer than 12l to the winner Dalston Lad but for hitting two out; heading in the right direction and respected.

runners_data.name: Padre Arthur
runners_data.note: Henderson's prominent racer carrying least weight at 156lbs with Nico de Boinville's tactical expertise a major asset
runners_data.comment: Beaten 15l into second at Kempton but the winner is useful and that was better
runners_data.spotlight: Only sixth in his first two races (debut was a bumper) but raised his profile when chasing home a talented and shorter-priced stablemate at Kempton in early February (2m5f, good to soft); he was 15l adrift but this 5yo no doubt has plenty more to offer.

runners_data.name: Intosomethinggood
runners_data.note: Most experienced over hurdles but prominent style may struggle if leaders set strong fractions throughout
runners_data.comment: 4-11 over hurdles so the most exposed of these; did win a good handicap last time
runners_data.spotlight: The most exposed of these after 11 runs over hurdles but it was win number four when returning to his best in a 2m5f Class 2 handicap at Kempton a month ago (hard fought; good ground); penalised accordingly and he might be vulnerable should one or two of these find the anticipated improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Le Beau Madrik and Legendary Luke will dispute the early lead in this small field, creating an honest gallop from the outset. With both confirmed front runners likely to maintain a strong pace throughout the 2m5f trip, the tempo should be searching rather than stop-start. The sustained pace will stretch the field and create gaps turning for home, with the winner likely emerging from those who can travel strongly in behind. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and strong travellers who can position close enough to strike, rather than hold-up horses who need a slower pace to unleash late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Le Beau Madrik and Legendary Luke go too fast early and both crack
scenarios.body: The honest gallop becomes unsustainable and the prominent racers inherit the lead with superior stamina reserves. Matty's Getaway and Padre Arthur benefit from their tactical positioning and stronger finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Le Beau Madrik or Legendary Luke gets the fractions right and maintains superiority
scenarios.body: One of the leaders establishes the perfect rhythm and has enough left to repel all challengers up the hill. The class and tactical speed of the early leader proves decisive over this demanding trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but sustainable, allowing close trackers to pounce
scenarios.body: The front runners set it up perfectly for those sitting in the slipstream to deliver telling challenges. Matty's Getaway or Padre Arthur time their moves to perfection as the leaders begin to weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If Intosomethinggood overcomes his prominent style to produce a late surge
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner uses his superior class to grind past tired leaders despite the pace not ideally suiting. His recent Kempton win provides the confidence to deliver when it matters most.

watchPoints.text: Le Beau Madrik may have trained on significantly during his 46-day break and could outclass this field completely
Legendary Luke's jumping efficiency after his below-par effort in the Grade 2 at this course 60 days ago
Matty's Getaway's fitness levels after 138 days off despite the first-time tongue-tie suggesting connections expect improvement
Early pace battle between Le Beau Madrik and Legendary Luke will determine whether prominent racers get their chance
Padre Arthur's jumping fluency under pressure as Henderson's horses often need their seasonal reappearance

races.name: Unibet Abram Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Girl Friday
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent form who should appreciate this step up in distance and handles today's good ground conditions well.
runners_data.comment: She's raised in class with little experience behind her but clearly useful
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £45,000 after winning a four-runner Irish mares' maiden point (3m, good); raced prominently and came home 4l to the good in a 2m3f maiden for mares at Wetherby; she's raised in class with little experience behind her but clearly useful.

runners_data.name: Great Dance
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer from small stable who needs the pace to collapse but showed enough bumper form to suggest ability when things fall right.
runners_data.comment: Bred for this longer distance but she'd be a surprise winner; tongue-tie added
runners_data.spotlight: Won a weak bumper at Newton Abbot on debut but was then well held in a Listed race and the form of her close third on hurdle debut at Taunton is nothing to shout about (2m, good); bred for this far but she'd be a surprise winner; tongue-tie added.

runners_data.name: White Noise
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with solid class edge over most of these but must prove stamina at this extended trip under top weight.

runners_data.name: Torpille Dagrostis
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with cheekpieces retained who brings strong Irish form but faces a significant step up in grade today.
runners_data.comment: It wasn't pretty in winning her maiden but her heart seems in the right place
runners_data.spotlight: Cheekpieces added for her last three races; it wasn't pretty when making hard work of justifying short odds in a Leopardstown maiden for mares in early March (2m5f, soft) but her heart seems in the right place and should run well again.

runners_data.name: Just A Glance
runners_data.note: Natural leader who stays well but may find the class demands too sharp despite her unbeaten hurdling record to date.
runners_data.comment: 2-2 over hurdles; should be fine over the longer distance but these terms are tough
runners_data.spotlight: Won a point bumper and followed up in a 2m4f maiden; unbeaten over hurdles after minor wins over 2m at Hereford (soft) and Chepstow (good to soft); should stay this longer trip fine but on the face of it these terms look tough.

runners_data.name: Dream Shadow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who meets White Noise on better weight terms than their previous encounter and should relish this longer distance.
runners_data.comment: 3m perhaps too far last time; previous run behind White Noise offers hope
runners_data.spotlight: Has just over 5l to find with White Noise on their Warwick clash in February (2m3f, heavy) but a 5lb pull with the winner can only help her cause and perhaps 3m on soft ground stretched her when a remote second at Doncaster (Listed); has to enter the reckoning.

runners_data.name: Livingonaprayer
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from a poor showing last time but has winning form at today's distance on similar ground conditions.
runners_data.comment: Dual winner; Doncaster was disappointing but probably wise to put a line through that
runners_data.spotlight: Won mares' novice races at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) and Wincanton (2m5f, good to soft) before pulling up when 18-1 for a Listed event at Doncaster (3m, soft); beaten too far out to blame the longer trip but it was a miserable day in South Yorkshire and plenty of horses underperformed on that card; could be given another chance.

runners_data.name: Millady
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who lacks the class to trouble these rivals but could benefit if the pace collapses in front of her.
runners_data.comment: Form of Hereford third gives her no right to be troubling the best of these
runners_data.spotlight: Improved to be third in a maiden at Hereford (2m3f, good) but that form gives her no right to be troubling the best of these.

races.paceDynamic: White Noise and Just A Glance will ensure a genuine gallop from the outset, with both confirmed front-runners unlikely to yield early supremacy easily. The honest pace will stretch the field over this stamina-testing 2m5f trip, creating tactical pressure points at the third-last and into the home straight. Dream Shadow, Torpille Dagrostis and Girl Friday can track the pace from prominent positions while Great Dance and Millady will need the leaders to overdo things from the rear. This searching gallop clearly favours prominent racers who can stay in touch without getting embroiled in the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If White Noise and Just A Glance engage in a prolonged speed duel through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The relentless tempo will find out stamina limitations and set up the race for horses tracking in third or fourth position. Those prominent but not committed early get the perfect tactical position to strike approaching the final flight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If White Noise or Just A Glance establish early dominance and dictate terms without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The lone leader controls fractions and kicks clear from three out, with superior class telling over this extended trip. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground against controlled but testing pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners tie up badly in the closing stages after over-racing early
scenarios.body: The race falls apart in the final half-mile, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep through a faltering field. Late pace becomes crucial as stamina reserves prove decisive over those who went too hard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Slow Early
scenarios.trigger: If neither leader wants the early responsibility and they settle into a steady rhythm
scenarios.body: The pace quickens dramatically from four out as the sprint home becomes crucial over this extended distance. Horses with natural tactical speed rather than pure stamina gain the advantage.

watchPoints.text: White Noise's early position - if she races too keenly against Just A Glance the pace could become unsustainably strong
Just A Glance's jumping rhythm - any mistakes early could compromise her front-running tactics against stronger opposition
Dream Shadow's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance approaching three out to use her staying power
Great Dance's ability to get competitive position - trainer's 1/4 recent record suggests limited current confidence
Torpille Dagrostis settling in cheekpieces - Irish raider must prove she can handle the pace step-up in this grade

races.name: Unibet Silver Trophy Handicap Chase (Grade 2) (A Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Outlaw Peter
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent C&D win in cheekpieces, trainer Paul Nicholls excels at placing horses tactically
runners_data.comment: Back up 6lb for his clearcut recent win in the Middle Distance Veterans' Final over C&D
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple winner who reacted well to the new cheekpieces when a clearcut winner of the Middle Distance Veterans' Final over C&D only 11 days ago; historically well treated despite the 6lb rise but there's a suspicion that younger limbs this time may have his measure.

runners_data.name: Fugitif
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from small stable with poor trainer recent form, needs pace collapse to be competitive

runners_data.name: Tommy's Oscar
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist stepping back from 3m trip, 38 days off could aid freshness for finishing kick
runners_data.comment: The drop back in trip is no cause for concern but a 5lb rise for that last win has to be
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who made his name as a two-miler and the slow pace helped when making his first foray over 3m a successful one at Carlisle (good to soft; effective on good); solid second the run before over 2m4f but a 5lb rise for last time could be troublesome.

runners_data.name: Bleu d'Enfer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping significantly in grade, Donald McCain team hitting form with 5/25 recent winners

runners_data.name: The Bluesman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent current form with three wins from last four starts, thrives on any ground

runners_data.name: Riskintheground
runners_data.note: Hold-up defender on dangerous mark but recent form nosedived badly, needs career revival
runners_data.comment: Won this last year off 1lb higher and signs of returning to form last time at Cheltenham
runners_data.spotlight: Won this race 12 months ago at Cheltenham when 1lb higher so he's dangerously handicapped for his defence; his form had nosedived after winning in a small field at Newton Abbot in October but the signs were more encouraging last time in the 2m4f Plate at the Festival as he was staying on when hampered by a faller at the last fence; has to be of interest, especially given the yard's form.

runners_data.name: Triple Trade
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who departed early 11 days ago, twice winner this season but unreliable jumping
runners_data.comment: Early casualty here 11 days ago; has a lot in his favour so merits each-way consideration
runners_data.spotlight: Still on a good mark despite winning twice this season (2m/2m4f; soft/good) and was 11-2 for the veterans' final over C&D earlier this month, only to depart early; has a lot in his favour so merits each-way consideration.

runners_data.name: Jour d'Evasion
runners_data.note: Sole pace-setter gives tactical advantage, hat-trick seeker but question marks over good ground effectiveness

runners_data.name: Mousey Brown
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare facing stiff task after 81 days off and poor recent hurdling form
runners_data.comment: Irish raider for whom trip/ground is ideal; revival needed but cheekpieces are new
runners_data.spotlight: Has faced stiff tasks over hurdles on her last two starts in races won by Wodhooh and Feet Of A Dancer; has a bit to prove on the wellbeing front as her runs before those (chasing and hurdling) weren't her best, but both her chase wins have been on good ground at about this trip and this Irish raider now goes in cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Moon d'Orange
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing new visor after Cheltenham third, 0-10 recent record but showed signs of revival
runners_data.comment: The new visor worked well when a never-nearer third in the Plate last month
runners_data.spotlight: 9lb higher when beaten 3.5l by Riskintheground 12 months ago; 0-10 in the meantime but the new visor worked well when a never-nearer third in the Plate at Cheltenham last month and clear claims if he can back that up.

runners_data.name: Zurich
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won at Cheltenham on good ground, would prefer race stayed at original venue
runners_data.comment: Had a good season and his fifth in last month's Plate at Cheltenham was admirable
runners_data.spotlight: Could have done without this race being transferred from Cheltenham as he won there in October (good ground) and stayed on well for fifth in last month's Plate; his run in between at Doncaster in a race that's worked out well was also admirable; every chance.

races.paceDynamic: Jour d'Evasion is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a measured gallop without pressure from fellow leaders. Outlaw Peter, Bleu d'Enfer and Zurich will sit prominent but won't force the pace, allowing Jour d'Evasion to control the tempo throughout the 2m4f trip. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Tommy's Oscar, The Bluesman, Triple Trade and Riskintheground will be content to settle in behind this steady rhythm. This sustainable pace strongly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as they can track the modest gallop and strike when the hold-up horses are still making ground from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Jour d'Evasion sets a steady gallop and prominent horses travel well
scenarios.body: The measured pace allows Outlaw Peter or Zurich to track the leader comfortably before unleashing their finish when hold-up horses are still working their way into contention. Their positioning advantage becomes decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens approaching the home turn or Jour d'Evasion weakens
scenarios.body: Tommy's Oscar or The Bluesman time their challenge perfectly, benefiting from the early pace battle before unleashing superior finishing kicks. Their class and stamina reserves prove telling despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Jour d'Evasion faces no serious pace pressure and maintains strong gallop
scenarios.body: The seven-year-old exploits his uncontested lead by gradually increasing tempo, building an unassailable advantage before the field can organize a meaningful challenge. His recent winning form and tactical position prove unbeatable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Jour d'Evasion stops suddenly or makes jumping errors
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse positioned within striking distance can capitalize on the disrupted pace dynamics. Tactical positioning becomes irrelevant as the field bunches dramatically.

watchPoints.text: Jour d'Evasion's jumping under pressure - any early errors could hand initiative to prominent trackers
Triple Trade's reliability at obstacles after early departure 11 days ago in veterans' final
Outlaw Peter's response to quicker ground conditions having won last two on softer surfaces
Tommy's Oscar's stamina reserves dropping back from successful 3m debut to this shorter trip
The Bluesman's ability to get competitive position from hold-up style given limited pace pressure

races.name: Try Unibets Smartview Racecards Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Huffin An A Puffin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 46-day break with form figures that suggest he's found his level in handicaps
runners_data.comment: The defeat of Storming George now looks good; excuses last time; had wind surgery
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Newbury novice hurdle in March 2024 (for Harry Derham) and returned from a long absence to make successful stable/handicap debut at Doncaster (2m3f, soft), beating none other than last week's Grade 1 winner Storming George; was found to be coughing after pulling up off this 3lb higher mark at Newbury (2m4f; favourite); interesting after wind surgery; should be well handicapped.

runners_data.name: La Pinsonniere
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with consistent record who benefits from strong pace and has Nico de Boinville's tactical nous
runners_data.comment: Likeably consistent and was third of 13 off this mark over Kempton's 2m5f a month ago
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in a Listed hurdle for mares at this fixture (Cheltenham) 12 months ago; only 1-12 but she's likeably consistent and was third of 13 off this mark over Kempton's 2m5f a month ago (good) having been given every chance; solid claims once more.

runners_data.name: Royal Infantry
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with proven stamina whose recent form shows he's competitive off this mark

runners_data.name: Norman Fletcher
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose five wins have all come at 2m-2m1f, raising stamina doubts over this 2m5f trip
runners_data.comment: Wasn't that strong through the line over Bangor's extended 2m3f last time
runners_data.spotlight: All five wins have been at about 2m or 2m1f; wasn't that strong through the line over Bangor's extended 2m3f last time (good) and has further to go here; tries cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Irandando Has
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form but representing a trainer with poor 14-day record (0/2)

runners_data.name: Idy Wood
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader coming off disappointing runs but has won twice over hurdles this season when right
runners_data.comment: Capable 8yo but on a recovery mission after finishing tailed on his last two starts
runners_data.spotlight: Won over fences last season and has won twice over hurdles since September; now he's on a recovery mission after very quiet runs at Windsor (2m4f) and at the Cheltenham Festival (3m; again on his favoured good ground).

runners_data.name: Below The Radar
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from Paul Nicholls stable with consistent placed form but no wins recently

runners_data.name: Le Tiep's Sacre
runners_data.note: Prominent 5-year-old making handicap debut after 32-day break, lightly raced with potential upside
runners_data.comment: Ran well to be fifth on handicap debut when entitled to need the race after a year off
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo; won a Fontwell maiden last March (2m1f, good to soft) and first sighting since then when beaten a shade over 3l on last month's handicap debut at Kempton; looked threatening until perhaps a lack of match sharpness told late on; in the mix.

runners_data.name: George's Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 110-day absence, caught stewards' attention last time when trying this trip
runners_data.comment: Needs to settle better than at Kempton; retains potential at this trip; had wind surgery
runners_data.spotlight: Has only won a maiden but there has been promise in his handicap runs and he caught the attention of the stewards when trying this far for the first time at Kempton on Boxing Day (good; off since); he did take a fierce hold on that occasion and will need to settle better here, but still interesting on the back of a wind operation.

runners_data.name: Johnson's Blue
runners_data.note: Front-runner whose recent chase form raises questions but could be well-handicapped returning to hurdles
runners_data.comment: Potentially on a useful mark if he can get back on track, but there are risks attached
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off on his final hurdle start in November and three subsequent chase runs leave him with further questions to answer; potentially on a useful mark if he can get back on track, but there are clearly risks attached.

runners_data.name: Masked Dance
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good recent form but stepping up significantly in class from her usual level
runners_data.comment: Highly likely to run another solid race but this is stronger than she's accustomed to
runners_data.spotlight: Better than ever in her last three starts over 2m5f and 3m; highly likely to run another solid race but this is stronger than she's accustomed to.

runners_data.name: Analiese
runners_data.note: Prominent 5-year-old with consistent record whose sole recent defeat came to a progressive rival
runners_data.comment: Progressive mare who has won three of her last four races; up just 3lb for the latest
runners_data.spotlight: Sole defeat in her last four races came at the hands of a progressive horse at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft); shrugged aside that minor blip with a workmanlike win at Chepstow (2m3f, soft); 3lb rise isn't the end of the world.

races.paceDynamic: Idy Wood and Johnson's Blue will ensure a genuine early gallop from the front, with both confirmed leaders needing to go forward. The prominent brigade of Huffin An A Puffin, Norman Fletcher, Le Tiep's Sacre, Masked Dance and Analiese creates serious traffic concerns turning for home, as five horses compete for prime position behind the leaders. With Royal Infantry, La Pinsonniere, Irandando Has, Below The Radar and George's Lad all held up, the pace injection from the leaders should set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to sweep through late. This race shape strongly favours the patient hold-up performers who can avoid the prominent traffic jam.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and the prominent bunch gets congested 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The patient trackers will have clear runs to exploit as the leaders tire and the prominent horses interfere with each other. Royal Infantry and La Pinsonniere are best positioned to capitalize with their proven stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If one of the forward horses can secure the ideal position just behind the leaders
scenarios.body: They'll have first run on the field while avoiding the hold-up traffic, with Huffin An A Puffin's recent form making him the most likely beneficiary. Analiese's consistent record also suits this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leaders battle home
scenarios.trigger: If both Idy Wood and Johnson's Blue are sharper than recent evidence suggests
scenarios.body: Their early advantage could prove decisive if the hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do, particularly with Johnson's Blue potentially well-handicapped. The strong gallop they set won't necessarily undo them if they're both back to form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unexpected winner emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race falls apart tactically with uneven pace or interference
scenarios.body: A horse with the right trip at the right time could steal it, with Irandando Has's recent consistency making him the most likely surprise package. Norman Fletcher's stamina concerns might be negated by tactical chaos.

watchPoints.text: Prominent traffic jam developing between Huffin An A Puffin, Norman Fletcher, Le Tiep's Sacre, Masked Dance and Analiese turning for home
Johnson's Blue's fitness after disappointing recent chase runs and long absence from hurdle racing
Norman Fletcher's stamina holding out over this extended 2m5f trip given his preference for shorter distances
George's Lad's readiness after 110-day layoff and whether he can recapture his Kempton form
Royal Infantry and Harry Skelton getting the right split through traffic when the hold-up horses make their move

races.name: Try Unibets New Racing Betbuilder Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Ki Woo
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who has won his only start on similar going, makes the running with confidence

runners_data.name: Holokea
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who excels on good ground with strong recent form, needs to overcome wide draw
runners_data.comment: Mown down late on in big field at Windsor (extended 3m4f, soft) in January three runs back
runners_data.spotlight: Won bumper and maiden hurdle when on good ground; scored at Ffos Las (3m1f, soft) in October and runner-up in four of his other six chases, including when mown down late on in a big field at Windsor (extended 3m4f, soft) in January; ran poorly over C&D next time and well beaten at Cheltenham Festival on latest but both those races were much warmer than this.

runners_data.name: Regarde
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 144-day break with wind operations, needs the run but proven over course and distance
runners_data.comment: Won over C&D (good) last March; has a good record when returning from a break; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Has had three wind operations, two of them last year; won four-runner race over C&D (good) when upped in trip last March and ran creditably on next two starts; not disgraced at Ascot in November when last seen; has a good record when returning from a break, so goes on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Red Delta
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who stays the trip well having won the Lincolnshire National, hard to peg back if leading late
runners_data.comment: Stays thoroughly and latest start (3m/hampered) can be forgiven; considered back at 3m4f
runners_data.spotlight: Stays thoroughly, having won the Lincolnshire National at Market Rasen (3m4f) on Boxing Day and performed well in the Eider at Newcastle (4m1f) in February; perhaps his heavy defeat over 3m on latest start can therefore be forgiven, particularly as he was hampered early on; considered back at 3m4f.

runners_data.name: Yes Day
runners_data.note: Prominent runner now 13lb below peak mark but hasn't fired this season, unconvincing recent form
runners_data.comment: Below form this term and didn't show much on good ground latest; won over 3m7f last March
runners_data.spotlight: He's now 13lb below his peak mark but hasn't been at his best this season and didn't show much when back on good ground (3m) three weeks ago; won over 3m7f last March but there may be more solid options.

runners_data.name: Some Scope
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer back to form in visor, second run after wind surgery suggests improvement to come
runners_data.comment: Has a competitive mark but his inconsistency and going beyond 3m2f both introduce doubts
runners_data.spotlight: Won from the front in first-time visor (kept since) at Doncaster in December; back to form when second at Newbury on latest start, his second run after his second wind operation; has a competitive mark but his inconsistency and going beyond 3m2f both introduce doubts.

runners_data.name: Fierce Warrior
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose best form is at shorter trips, question marks over stamina at this extended distance
runners_data.comment: Furthest he's been is 3m2f when rallying to beat Red Delta at Doncaster (soft) in November
runners_data.spotlight: The furthest he's been was 3m2f when he rallied to win from Red Delta in a small field at Doncaster (soft; made most) in November; something amiss next time but he was back on song for second at Carlisle (3m, good to soft; probably effective on good) on latest outing, making it good runs on both his starts in cheekpieces; up 2lb but needs a close look.

runners_data.name: Gold Emery
runners_data.note: Prominent type who has never won over fences despite multiple placed efforts, all form on soft ground
runners_data.comment: Running creditably and stays, but no win from 16 attempts over fences (runner-up in seven)
runners_data.spotlight: All starts on softer than good; no win from 16 attempts over fences but runner-up in seven, including off this mark when he tried an extended 3m6f in the North Wales National at Bangor on penultimate start; ran creditably over 3m7f at Chepstow latest, so has place claims again but he does not look the percentage call for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Fortunedefortunata
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with poor recent form since joining new yard, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Out of form for Gordon Elliott; fell mid-race here 11 days ago on debut for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Mostly campaigned in competitive staying chases when with Gordon Elliott and did not accomplish much this season; £3,000 buy in February but fell mid-race here 11 days ago on debut for new yard; cheekpieces (tried once) return; major questions to answer.

runners_data.name: The Grey Man
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with recent wins but no form on good ground, significant weight advantage

runners_data.name: Bodhisattva
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in first-time visor who stays well but trainer out of form, longshot claims
runners_data.comment: Stays well; heavy defeats on last three outings but soft ground may not have been ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Third of five finishers in the 3m7f Edinburgh National at Musselburgh in February, which wasn't as good as his second in the same race in 2025; heavy defeats on last three outings but soft ground may not have been ideal.

races.paceDynamic: Ki Woo will dictate from the front with Red Delta, Yes Day, Fierce Warrior and Gold Emery settling prominently behind, creating a moderate but sustainable gallop over this marathon trip. The lack of genuine speed horses means the pace will be testing but not frantic, with the real race beginning from the home turn as the stamina-laden field strings out. Some Scope, Holokea and Regarde will need to mount late challenges from their hold-up positions as the prominent runners kick for home. This moderate early pace followed by a stamina test clearly favours the prominent racers who can track the leaders and have first run when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows the prominent group to stay in touch without over-racing
scenarios.body: Ki Woo and Red Delta can dictate terms before the hold-up horses get organised, with their superior positions giving them first run in the straight. The marathon distance becomes a war of attrition that favours those already in striking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady enough to leave plenty in reserve for the closers
scenarios.body: Holokea and Some Scope can produce devastating late kicks as the prominent runners weaken after setting strong fractions. Their fresh legs and proven stamina reserves overwhelm tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Gold Emery Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the handicap mark of just 149lbs proves decisive in the closing stages
scenarios.body: Gold Emery's weight advantage becomes telling as better-rated rivals tire, allowing him to pick off fading leaders despite his moderate form. His prominent position and light weight combination proves unbeatable in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or mistakes significantly alter the complexion of the race
scenarios.body: The Grey Man or Bodhisattva inherit winning positions as market principles are thrown out by jumping errors. A messy race where class and ratings matter less than staying upright rewards the survivors.

watchPoints.text: Ki Woo could get an easy lead if no other pace angles emerge, making him very difficult to peg back
Holokea's draw and hold-up style could leave him with too much ground to make up in a steadily-run race
Some Scope's second run after wind surgery often produces significant improvement for this yard
Yes Day's poor recent form suggests his confidence is shot despite the drop in grade
The Grey Man's 148lbs is significantly lighter than his main rivals, watch for late progress

races.name: Read Nicky Hendersons Unibet Blog Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Moon Rocket
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner returning from 34-day break with strong course record but needs to prove stamina at this extended trip

runners_data.name: Red Risk
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with retained ability at 11 years old, won Pertemps qualifier in February and handles this distance well
runners_data.comment: Uttoxeter was disappointing but he's shown bouncebackability in the past
runners_data.spotlight: Retains lots of ability despite his advancing years and won a Pertemps qualifier at Musselburgh in February (3m, good to soft); Uttoxeter was disappointing in a race he won the previous year, but he's shown bouncebackability in the past.

runners_data.name: Serious Chat
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but carries top weight of 168lbs after impressive half-length second at Doncaster last time
runners_data.comment: Probably ran as well as he ever has when beaten half a length at Doncaster last time
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of three handicaps, at 2m7f, 2m6f and 2m3f; probably ran as well as he ever has when beaten half a length at Doncaster last time (3m, soft); thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Lord Snootie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing best form for ages with recent Bangor second, well-treated on 147lbs after 25-day break
runners_data.comment: His best run for ages when a rallying second at Bangor last month; weighted to win races
runners_data.spotlight: Only 1-17 but has flashes of smart form in good handicaps and easily his best run for ages when a rallying second at Bangor last month (2m7f, good; effective on softer); weighted to win races and seriously considered.

runners_data.name: Red Dirt Road
runners_data.note: Natural leader who can have off days but showed class when fourth in Pertemps qualifier over course and distance
runners_data.comment: A sitting duck when ridden prominently in the Pertemps Final; better can be expected
runners_data.spotlight: He can have his off days but he's 4-12 over hurdles and he ran well to be fourth in a Pertemps qualifier over C&D before dropping out in the final furlong after racing up with the pace; he was always likely to prove a sitting duck when it mattered at Cheltenham and better can be expected here.

runners_data.name: Firestream
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 32-day absence with first-time cheekpieces applied after positive Uttoxeter run
runners_data.comment: Very lightly raced at nine; good run last time and chance if the wheels can stay on
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden/handicap wins for Anthony Honeyball; long absences a feature in his profile but there were positives at Uttoxeter last month (2m4f, soft; first-time cheekpieces) where he ran well for a long way; stays this far; chance if the wheels can stay on.

runners_data.name: Dartan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making hurdles return after 180-day break but warning flag over tendency to fade in finishes
runners_data.comment: Early days with this yard but appears to have developed some of his own ideas
runners_data.spotlight: Useful hurdler in Ireland; beaten in a match over fences on stable debut (first-time visor); this return to hurdles is welcomed but he appears to have developed some of his own ideas; had wind surgery.

runners_data.name: Smokeringinthedark
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent form with trainer Nicky Richards operating at 9/11 strike rate, just 15 days since last run

runners_data.name: Kilwaughter
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who won handicap debut at Newbury, amateur jockey Jack Stenhouse takes valuable 7lb allowance
runners_data.comment: 7lb rise for last time seems harsh enough but he'll probably improve again for going 3m
runners_data.spotlight: Smart in bumpers and getting there over hurdles after digging deep for a successful handicap debut under Jack Stenhouse at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft); 7lb rise seems harsh enough but he'll probably improve again for going 3m.

runners_data.name: King Of The Lake
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying first-time tongue tie but trainer Jeremy Scott has poor 0/11 recent record
runners_data.comment: He was a 33-1 chance last month at Uttoxeter and he ran like one
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins in 2025 and now only 2lb higher than for the last of those at Chepstow in December (2m7f, good to soft); however, he was a 33-1 chance last month at Uttoxeter and he ran like one.

races.paceDynamic: Moon Rocket and Red Dirt Road will clash from the start as both confirmed front runners, creating an honest early gallop at 3m½f. The middle stages will see congestion develop as Serious Chat, Lord Snootie, Firestream, Dartan, and King Of The Lake all want prominent positions, creating traffic dangers approaching the business end. Smokeringinthedark and Kilwaughter sitting at the back will have plenty to do if the pace becomes too strong early. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can navigate the prominent congestion and benefit from a strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Moon Rocket and Red Dirt Road go hard from flag-fall and maintain pressure
scenarios.body: The early leaders burn out after 2½ miles, creating perfect conditions for closers to sweep past tired horses. Smokeringinthedark and Kilwaughter get ideal setups from their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the middle pack gets bunched approaching 3 out with leaders still in front
scenarios.body: Four or five horses converge for position simultaneously, causing interference and blocked runs. The horse who gets first run from the pack or avoids trouble entirely prevails.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one early leader gets an easy time up front while the other fades
scenarios.body: Moon Rocket or Red Dirt Road capitalizes on a lack of early pressure to control the tempo and kick clear. The prominent horses can't bridge the gap despite the moderate pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders maintain relentless pressure throughout the 3m½f journey
scenarios.body: The extreme pace creates a war of attrition that only the strongest stayers can handle. Dartan's fading tendency becomes crucial as others also struggle home.

watchPoints.text: Moon Rocket and Red Dirt Road must be monitored early to see if both commit to genuine pace-making battle
Serious Chat carries 168lbs top weight and any signs of struggling under burden could signal trouble for prominent horses
Dartan returns from 180-day absence and needs watching for jumping fluency on hurdles comeback
Amateur riders Jack Stenhouse and Chad Bament could get squeezed out in the prominent congestion approaching 3 out
Smokeringinthedark needs clear sight of leaders turning for home to unleash finishing kick from hold-up position

races.name: Unibet Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hang In There
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returns after 46-day break with solid recent course form, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Encouraging third at Newbury last time and this ground should be more suitable
runners_data.spotlight: Strike-rate of 9-27 over fences and his third in a veterans' chase at Newbury in February (3m2f) was encouraging given he had been absent for three months and good to soft ground would have been slow enough; should run well.

runners_data.name: Iron Bridge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong staying power, solid recent efforts suggest ready to strike, suits this trip perfectly
runners_data.comment: Strong stayer but with a strike-rate of only 2-17 over fences and excuses are wearing thin
runners_data.spotlight: A strong stayer but with a strike-rate of only 2-17 over fences and excuses are wearing thin; on the plus side, they were solid enough efforts on last two starts (3m4f/3m6f) and he nearly won off this mark on his reappearance (3m2f).

runners_data.name: Bhaloo
runners_data.note: Prominent style but inconsistent profile, 137-day absence is concerning despite Henderson's 5/24 recent record
runners_data.comment: Even if back on song after a break his form figures at 3m or beyond are PPP
runners_data.spotlight: All-or-nothing profile and it's been nothing on his last two starts, while even if he was able to rediscover some spark after another break, his form figures at 3m or beyond are PPP; hardly the safest option.

runners_data.name: Millforce
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 171-day lay-off for new yard, needs to show continued improvement from Irish form
runners_data.comment: Absent since October when he signed off for Gavin Cromwell with a 2m6f win at Galway
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since October when he signed off for Gavin Cromwell with a 2m6f win at Galway (yielding); stays 3m and should get this far, but would need to see some confidence behind him.

runners_data.name: Egbert
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent course record (2-2), stamina concerns over this extended trip are the main worry
runners_data.comment: 2-2 here but the glaring concern is his nothing run at Exeter last time
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner in December 2024 (heavy; won on good) and made it 2-2 here when beating three rivals over 3m4f (good to soft) on reappearance; the glaring concern is his nothing run at Exeter last time when in trouble a long way out.

runners_data.name: Hold Your Fort
runners_data.note: Prominent/front-running style with recent course win, low weight and in-form conditional jockey booking catches eye
runners_data.comment: Dominated his two rivals from the front at Ascot (3m, good); up 5lb; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Did well in the autumn and won again last month at Ascot (3m, good) where he dominated his two rivals from the front; there's a suspicion that his two rivals underperformed and he's 5lb higher here, but still considered.

runners_data.name: Grand Geste
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent course form over similar distances, inconsistency remains the main concern
runners_data.comment: Strong form claims back on his favourite track; good ground would be a slight concern
runners_data.spotlight: Suffered two flops in his last three races but the latest was in the National Hunt Chase at Cheltenham; both wins since December have been here (3m1f/3m4f), latterly in the 11-runner Grand National Trial that always takes some winning; if on a going day then he would have strong claims, for all that softer ground would be preferred.

runners_data.name: Minella Crooner
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner but poor recent form makes him vulnerable despite likely pace advantage
runners_data.comment: Left Gordon Elliott on a downer and has continued in similar vein for current team
runners_data.spotlight: Once very smart for Gordon Elliott but left that yard on a downer and has continued in similar vein for current team; too risky at the minute.

races.paceDynamic: Minella Crooner will likely lead from the off with Hold Your Fort potentially tracking close behind, both having prominent styles and recent front-running tendencies. The early pace should be manageable given only these two are natural pace-setters, creating a rhythm that allows the field to settle into position without excessive early pressure. Iron Bridge, Bhaloo, Grand Geste and Millforce will sit prominently in behind, while Hang In There and Egbert drop towards the rear as hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick from 3-4 furlongs out, as the lack of genuine pace pressure will leave them perfectly positioned to strike when the gallop intensifies.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and no horse gets away from the field
scenarios.body: The prominent runners tracking Minella Crooner will be ideally positioned when the tempo lifts approaching the final mile. Iron Bridge, Grand Geste and Hold Your Fort can all strike from their forward positions while the hold-up horses face too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong early with multiple horses vying for the lead
scenarios.body: A fast early gallop would set up perfectly for Hang In There and Egbert to close from the rear. Their stamina reserves and tactical position would prove decisive in a truly-run staying test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Crooner leads unchallenged and slows the gallop significantly
scenarios.body: A crawling pace would turn this into a sprint finish where class tells and any horse with a turn of foot benefits. Bhaloo's ability and Grand Geste's recent course form could prove decisive in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Hold Your Fort or Minella Crooner gets an uncontested lead and stays strong
scenarios.body: An uncontested leader could prove difficult to peg back over this trip on good ground. Hold Your Fort's recent front-running win suggests he has the stamina to sustain his effort.

watchPoints.text: Minella Crooner could get an uncontested lead if Hold Your Fort tracks rather than challenges early
Hang In There needs the pace to be genuine throughout to get his preferred strong finish
Iron Bridge has shown solid recent form and the prominent position could prove ideal in this race shape
Bhaloo's 137-day absence combined with his inconsistent profile makes him very difficult to trust
Grand Geste's recent course wins suggest Haydock suits him well despite the step up in class

races.name: Unibet Pony Racing Authority Graduates Handicap Hurdle (Conditional Jockeys' And Amateur Riders')

runners_data.name: Count Of Vendome
runners_data.note: Front-runner in excellent form with proven stamina at this trip, 33 days since last run keeps him sharp

runners_data.name: Vocito
runners_data.note: Returning front-runner after 147-day break with class advantage but ring-rust concerns from long absence
runners_data.comment: Exposed but could be all the better for a break and he's on his last winning mark
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner over hurdles but exposed and was performing no more than okay when last seen in November; however, he could be all the better for a break and he's on his last winning mark.

runners_data.name: Lively Citizen
runners_data.note: Prominent racer switching back to hurdles after two chase pull-ups, proven at this level when right
runners_data.comment: There's a big run in him back over hurdles if he can get his act together
runners_data.spotlight: Very capable over fences but pulled up in that discipline on his last two starts following a break of 217 days; he did go close over hurdles at Aintree three runs ago so there's a big effort in him if he can get his act together.

runners_data.name: Brendas Asking
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 357-day layoff with winning form fresh in memory from Ludlow success
runners_data.comment: Has the form to feature off this mark if on her game after a year out
runners_data.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle at Ludlow in October 2024 (2m, good) and the following April a novice back at the same venue, after flying too high at the Cheltenham Festival; has the form to feature off this mark if on her game after a year out.

runners_data.name: Courageous Strike
runners_data.note: Non-runner

runners_data.name: Scintillante
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent form but coming back from 185-day break after disappointing Welsh Champion effort
runners_data.comment: Outclassed on final run in October; he had been running well prior to that
runners_data.spotlight: 5lb out of the weights and 50-1 when well beaten in the Welsh Champion Hurdle on final run in October; his earlier races were more realistic than that and he ran well; solid chance if fitness doesn't hold him back.

runners_data.name: Across Earth
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer who ran well in defeat at Newbury last time, proven at this level
runners_data.comment: It was a pretty good handicap in which he went down narrowly at Newbury the last time
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent for a while now and, although beaten off this mark on his last two starts, it was a pretty good handicap in which he went down narrowly at Newbury the last time (2m, good to soft); thereabouts if gelling with Jude Fernandes.

runners_data.name: Innamorato
runners_data.note: Progressive type for powerful Nicholls yard, won well at Taunton last time and handles testing conditions
runners_data.comment: Probably improving and interesting on handicap debut if okay on this quicker ground
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on the Flat and over hurdles in France; it was a quiet start for Paul Nicholls but came good in a heavy-ground maiden at Taunton (2m3f) and then ran third in a slowly run race at Newbury (good to soft; form franked); open to improvement in a race of this nature (handicap debut), though he did swerve a recent Ascot engagement on account of good ground so watch the weather.

races.paceDynamic: Count Of Vendome and Vocito will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead in this small field. Count Of Vendome's excellent recent form (1-2121) suggests he'll be aggressive, while Vocito returns from a 147-day break and may try to dictate. The pace will be honest but not suicidal over this 1m7½f trip, creating a searching test from halfway. This shape favors prominent racers and hold-up horses with tactical speed, as the leaders may weaken late after their early duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Duel Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Count Of Vendome and Vocito engage in a sustained battle from the start
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably strong, setting up the race perfectly for closers with finishing kicks. Hold-up horses like Brendas Asking and Scintillante benefit from the collapse ahead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Count Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If Count Of Vendome breaks clear of Vocito and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easier time and his proven stamina over this trip allows him to stay on strongly. Recent winners often repeat quickly and his 33-day break keeps him sharp.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Vocito Bounces Back
scenarios.trigger: If Vocito's 147-day freshness gives him the edge over a long absence
scenarios.body: The returning horse uses his class advantage to dominate late, with prominent racers tracking his move. His four hurdle wins show he has the ability when right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Deadlock Forms
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too steady trying to outfox each other
scenarios.body: The pace collapses completely, turning it into a sprint finish that suits the most naturally speedy. Prominent racers with tactical pace get first run on the field.

watchPoints.text: Count Of Vendome could steal a march if he breaks clear early while Vocito needs time to find his rhythm after the layoff
Brendas Asking's 357-day absence is extreme even with previous winning form at Ludlow to recommend him
Lively Citizen's switch back to hurdles could spark improvement after two disappointing chase efforts
Scintillante was well beaten in the Welsh Champion Hurdle and needs to bounce back from that poor effort
The pace battle between Count Of Vendome and Vocito will likely determine whether leaders or closers prevail
